انتفضوا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَفَضُوا (intafaḍū) /in.ta.fa.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْتَفَضَ (intafaḍa)
# اِنْتَفِضُوا (intafiḍū) /in.ta.fi.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْتَفَضَ (intafaḍa)
